integrity: A full analytic proof is given. Reproducible exact finite and integral checks are corroboration, not independent validation or a proof of priority.
limitations: Uniform perfect matchings and total two-chord crossing and nesting counts only; no rate for the bivariate central limit theorem. Historical-priority risk persists for possible earlier mixed enumerators.
title: Exact crossing–nesting covariance and asymptotic independence in uniform chord diagrams
